messages.text: Shelton beats Alcaraz at 3.33am in New York epic

metadata.summary: Ben Shelton clinched the biggest win of his career as he defeated defending champion Carlos Alcaraz in a five-set epic stretching deep into the New York night to reach the semi-finals of the US Open.
metadata.content: US Open: Ben Shelton beats Carlos Alcaraz in five-set thriller in latest-ever finish to US Open match at 3.33am | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to content US Open: Ben Shelton beats Carlos Alcaraz in five-set thriller in latest-ever finish to US Open match at 3.33am Ben Shelton clinches first-ever victory over top-three opponent as he beats Carlos Alcaraz to set up US Open semi-final showdown with Frances Tiafoe; watch the US Open live on Sky Sports Tennis and Sky Sports+, streaming service NOW and the Sky Sports app Wednesday 9 September 2026 12:37, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the thrilling US Open quarter-final between Ben Shelton and Carlos Alcaraz Ben Shelton clinched the biggest win of his career as he defeated defending champion Carlos Alcaraz in a five-set epic stretching deep into the New York night to reach the semi-finals of the US Open. The American prevailed 6-7 (5-7) 6-1 6-3 1-6 7-6 (10-7) over four hours and 28 minutes to reward a raucous Arthur Ashe Stadium crowd gripped until 3.33am in what was the latest-ever finish to a US Open match. It marked Shelton's first career win over a top-three player, against which he had been 0-17 coming into the match. Shelton will now play Frances Tiafoe in the final four after his fellow countryman's thrilling five-set victory over Alex Michelsen earlier in the evening. messages.text: From honeymoon vision to the Super Bowl - can Seahawks win it all again?

metadata.summary: Honeymoons are for newlyweds celebrating true love and for future NFL head coaches plotting Super Bowl glory. At least in the case of Mike Macdonald, who has now turned to the Chicago Bulls as his recipe reference for a repeat.
metadata.content: Seattle Seahawks: Jaxon Smith-Njigba's NFL warning, Mike Macdonald's honeymoon vision and the Super Bowl champions' quest for repeat | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to content Exclusive Seattle Seahawks: Jaxon Smith-Njigba's NFL warning, Mike Macdonald's honeymoon vision and the Super Bowl champions' quest for repeat Seattle Seahawks wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba says Sam Darnold 'shut up the naysayers' by leading his side to Super Bowl glory; Darnold and Smith-Njigba's Seahawks open the 2026 NFL season against the New England Patriots on Wednesday night, live on Sky Sports from 1.20am Thursday Tuesday 8 September 2026 15:24, UK Honeymoons are for newlyweds celebrating true love and for future NFL head coaches plotting Super Bowl glory. At least in the case of Mike Macdonald, who has now turned to the Chicago Bulls as his recipe reference for a repeat. Mystic Macdonald went viral earlier this year when the Seattle Seahawks released footage of his first-ever team meeting upon being appointed in 2024. Within it, he had strayed from his script to forecast a place at the NFC Championship Game and an 'inevitable' feel to a 'won't die, won't quit' machine. "It probably came to me about 30 minutes before the meeting," Macdonald tells Sky Sports of his viral speech. Between some fine fortune-telling and a relentless winning formula, that vision became a reality 21 months later as Seattle beat the Los Angeles Rams to reach Super Bowl LX. Naomi Osaka has hit back at critics of her iconic fashion choices after lighting up the US Open with her menu of statement outfits. The two-time US Open champion may have lost a lopsided fourth-round match to Elena Rybakina but she continued to make her mark as the undisputed fashion queen on tour. Osaka, already known for her walk-on fashion reveals at tournaments, has been upping her game at the year's final major with a series of dramatic ensembles - all with a basketball theme as her sponsor, Nike, honours the New York Knicks' championship win.
